name: Omega
description: Central simulation controller, accessed as O. Manages scene, bodies, engines, and simulation lifecycle.

attributes.name: iter
attributes.description: Get current step number

attributes.name: subStep
attributes.description: Get the current subStep number (only meaningful if O.subStepping==True); -1 when outside the loop, otherwise either 0 (O.subStepping==False) or number of engine to be run (O.subStepping==True)

attributes.name: subStepping
attributes.description: Get/set whether subStepping is active.

attributes.name: stopAtIter
attributes.description: Get/set number of iteration after which the simulation will stop.

attributes.name: stopAtTime
attributes.description: Get/set time after which the simulation will stop.

attributes.name: time
attributes.description: Return virtual (model world) time of the simulation.

attributes.name: realtime
attributes.description: Return clock (human world) time the simulation has been running.

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: Return current calculation speed [iter/sec].

attributes.name: dt
attributes.description: Current timestep (Δt) value. See dynDt for enabling/disabling automatic Δt updates through a TimeStepper.

attributes.name: dynDt
attributes.description: Whether a TimeStepper (when present in O.engines) is used for dynamic Δt control.

attributes.name: dynDtAvailable
attributes.description: Whether a TimeStepper is amongst O.engines, activated or not.

attributes.name: running
attributes.description: Whether background thread is currently running a simulation.

attributes.name: filename
attributes.description: Filename under which the current simulation was saved (None if never saved).

attributes.name: thisScene
attributes.description: Return current scene's id.

attributes.name: engines
attributes.description: List of engines in the simulation (corresponds to Scene::engines in C++ source code).

attributes.name: miscParams
attributes.description: MiscParams in the simulation (Scene::mistParams), usually used to save serializables that don't fit anywhere else, like GL functors

attributes.name: bodies
attributes.description: Bodies in the current simulation (container supporting index access by id and iteration)

attributes.name: interactions
attributes.description: Access to interactions of simulation, by using #. id's of both Bodies of the interactions, e.g. O.interactions[23,65] #. iteraction over the whole container:: for i in O.interactions: print i.id1,i.id2 .. note:: Iteration silently skips interactions that are not real.

attributes.name: materials
attributes.description: Shared materials; they can be accessed by id or by label

attributes.name: forces
attributes.description: ForceContainer (forces, torques, displacements) in the current simulation.

attributes.name: energy
attributes.description: EnergyTracker of the current simulation. (meaningful only with O.trackEnergy)

attributes.name: trackEnergy
attributes.description: When energy tracking is enabled or disabled in this simulation.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags (string=string dictionary) of the current simulation (container supporting string-index access/assignment)

attributes.name: timingEnabled
attributes.description: Globally enable/disable timing services (see documentation of the timing module).

attributes.name: forceSyncCount
attributes.description: Counter for number of syncs in ForceContainer, for profiling purposes.

attributes.name: numThreads
attributes.description: Get maximum number of threads openMP can use.

attributes.name: cell
attributes.description: Periodic Cell of the current scene (None if the scene is aperiodic).

attributes.name: periodic
attributes.description: Get/set whether the scene is periodic or not (True/False).

methods.name: load
methods.description: load( (Omega)arg1, (str)file [, (bool)quiet=False]) -> None : Load simulation from file. The file should have been saved in the same version of Yade built or compiled with the

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reload current simulation

methods.name: save
methods.description: save( (Omega)arg1, (str)file [, (bool)quiet=False]) -> None : Save current simulation to file (should be .xml or .xml.bz2 or .yade or .yade.gz). .xml files are bigger than .yade, but can be more

methods.name: loadTmp
methods.description: loadTmp( (Omega)arg1 [, (str)mark='' [, (bool)quiet=False]]) -> None : Load simulation previously stored in memory by saveTmp. *mark* optionally distinguishes multiple saved simulations

methods.name: saveTmp
methods.description: saveTmp( (Omega)arg1 [, (str)mark='' [, (bool)quiet=False]]) -> None : Save simulation to memory (disappears at shutdown), can be loaded later with loadTmp. *mark* optionally distinguishes differ

methods.name: lsTmp
methods.description: Return list of all memory-saved simulations.

methods.name: tmpToFile
methods.description: Save XML of saveTmp'd simulation into *fileName*.

methods.name: tmpToString
methods.description: Return XML of saveTmp'd simulation as string.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Run the simulation. *nSteps* how many steps to run, then stop (if positive); *wait* will cause not returning to python until simulation will have stopped.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: pause( (Omega)arg1) -> None : Stop simulation execution. (May be called from within the loop, and it will stop after the current step).

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advance the simulation by one step. Returns after the step will have finished.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: wait( (Omega)arg1) -> None : Don't return until the simulation will have been paused. (Returns immediately if not running).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: reset( (Omega)arg1) -> None : Reset simulations completely (including another scenes!).

methods.name: resetThisScene
methods.description: Reset current scene.

methods.name: resetCurrentScene
methods.description: Reset current scene.

methods.name: resetAllScenes
methods.description: Reset all scenes.

methods.name: addScene
methods.description: Add new scene to Omega, returns its number

methods.name: switchToScene
methods.description: Switch to defined scene. Default scene has number 0, other scenes have to be created by addScene method.

methods.name: switchScene
methods.description: Switch to alternative simulation (while keeping the old one). Calling the function again switches back to the first one. Note that most variables from the first simulation will still refer to the first simulation even after the switch (e.g. b=O.bodies[4]; O.switchScene(); [b still refers to the body in the first simulation here])

methods.name: sceneToString
methods.description: Return the entire scene as a string. Equivalent to using O.save(...) except that the scene goes to a string instead of a file. (see also stringToScene())

methods.name: stringToScene
methods.description: Load simulation from a string passed as argument (see also sceneToString).

methods.name: labeledEngine
methods.description: Return instance of engine/functor with the given label. This function shouldn't be called by the user directly; every ehange in O.engines will assign respective global python variables according to labels. For example: *O.engines=[InsertionSortCollider(label='collider')]* *collider.nBins=5 # collider has become a variable after assignment to O.engines automatically*

methods.name: resetTime
methods.description: Reset simulation time: step number, virtual and real time. (Doesn't touch anything else, including timings).

methods.name: plugins
methods.description: Return list of all plugins registered in the class factory.

methods.name: childClassesNonrecursive
methods.description: Return list of all classes deriving from given class, as registered in the class factory

methods.name: isChildClassOf
methods.description: Tells whether the first class derives from the second one (both given as strings).

methods.name: exitNoBacktrace
methods.description: Disable SEGV handler and exit, optionally with given status number.

methods.name: disableGdb
methods.description: Revert SEGV and ABRT handlers to system defaults.

methods.name: runEngine
methods.description: Run given engine exactly once; simulation time, step number etc. will not be incremented (use only if you know what you do).

methods.name: tmpFilename
methods.description: Return unique name of file in temporary directory which will be deleted when yade exits.

methods.name: intrsctToBytes
methods.description: returns a copy of intersections[rank] (a vector<int>) from a subdomain in the form of bytes. Returns a copy mirrorIntersections[rank] if mirror=True.

methods.name: bufferFromIntrsct
methods.description: returns a (char*) pointer to the underying buffer of intersections[rank], so that it can be overwritten. Size must be passed in advance. Pointer to mirrorIntersections[rank] is returned if mirror=True. Python syntax: bufferFromIntrsct(...)[:]=bytes(something)
